reviews.review: Plays more like a doom 2016 speedrun without glitches.

Fantastic rouge like game with great replayability! The game feels like the love child of doom and borderlands and will please those who are looking for the fast pace action shooter genre. However, the game feels short once u finished the "final" boss and is in need of more content update. There are some animation issues on your "Bro-bot" when in multiplayer, such as: there aren't any, which - although - a little immersion breaking, it doesn't take away the fun of the game and would hopefully be patched sooner, along with additional contents and stages. Multiplayer, however, is only 2 players at most which is a little underwhelming but understandable since the game needs to be updated in terms of scaling and map size in some areas.

(Gifted by a Friend)

On a technical level the Game is already finished, aside from the occasional Crashes and an FPS drop here and there that can be fixed with a restart. But it happened only twice so its not game braking.

And some bugs notably Reviving as a Recon-Robot in stealth sometimes doenst work, and being in a downed state during the DiggyMole boss fight , the boss can push you inside the Walls and render you un-revivable .

It smooth as a Shooter-fps-RogueLike, it just has a lot of content that seems to be made or in the works for a Future update or maybe DLC.

All that's missing is just more content like Characters, Gun Randomizers, Gadgets, enemies, Robot Classes. and any post game content. It IS a RogueLike so it should really strive to hook you after beating the game.

in summary ;

Good graphical style
Fitting music
Fluid Gameplay 
Enjoyable Roguelike Shooter for its price
        Despite the;
Rare occasions of an FPS drop
apparent Missing content(there are some doors labeled "Under Construction")
and no 4player co-op
chill, quite decent minimalist shooter, good gameplay and skillz. updates have been really nice. good to jump in to now and then.
